title: The hypertrophy series: determining optimal training durations
summary: He argues there is no fixed ideal session length: training time is however long it takes to reach your maximum recoverable volume, and it depends on frequency, intensity, volume and training age. He calls the 60-90 minute cortisol/testosterone cap a myth that makes lifters cram volume. His own sessions run up to three hours.
claims: The gym is not social time; chatting and phone use add time that is not training
There are no absolutes for session length; it depends on the individual and their training level
You can keep one-hour sessions for years, but the tonnage done within that hour changes
Time affects intensity: shorter rests and more prior work make each set more intense
Cramming a 90-minute program into 60 minutes raises intensity in a non-optimal way; know how long your program takes, and if a 2-hour plan takes 3 you misjudged it
For size, session length is however long it takes to reach your maximum recoverable volume, which you can only estimate within a ballpark
The claim that training over 60-90 minutes is wasted because cortisol rises, testosterone crashes and you turn catabolic is nonsense
An arbitrary time cap makes people stack too much volume into a short window, then they claim they cannot recover from volume training
If you progress in 25-35 minutes, train that long; otherwise more effort is better as long as you avoid injury and overreaching
Overtraining only exists relative to a program because it depends on frequency
The more you grow the longer sessions get; you can compress them with higher intensity, supersets, shorter rests and dense rep schemes
Session length depends on frequency, intensity and volume; someone training three days a week naturally has longer days than someone training five
Spend as much time as needed to reach the day's goal; a light GPP day can be done in 20 minutes
He is at the high end: his strength work is high but not maximal intensity with little tonnage, so he follows it with many supersetted variations and accessories, and workouts run up to 3 hours
